_comment: THE REQUEST BOARD's live posting pool. Assembled VERBATIM from docs/archive/staging/board-staging/guild-bounties.json -- copy/giver/condition/gold carried over unchanged, _notes/_comment_* annotations stripped per the G2 discipline. Pool order is LOAD-BEARING (WIBounties.active_slate: rotation index = times_slept % pool.size(), zero rng) -- do not reorder without re-deriving every canonical seed that touches the board. `bounty_crab_cull` (the staging doc's 10th entry) is PARKED, not shipped: its condition names a bank (`rock_crabs_culled`) that doesn't exist until HR-II lands a Rock Crab encounter -- the staging doc itself flags 'keep OUT of the live pool until HR-II lands', so this file ships the 9 bounties that ride REAL, already-produced accomplishment counters (won_combat/persuaded_someone/heard_gossip/observed_things/found_phosphor_moss+read_drainage_marker/found_spider_silk/served_customer/cooked_meal/cleared_sewer_vermin -- every one cross-checked against a real on_victory/on_skill_use/on_interact_accomplishment/talk_pool producer in skeleton_scene.json before this file was written). Conditions use the quests.json complete_when dict shape (multi-key = AND). Evaluation mode is PER-BOUNTY via an OPTIONAL `condition_mode` field (default "delta" when absent -- WIGame.accept_bounty snapshots each condition key's accomplishment_count as a baseline; WIBounties.condition_met compares CURRENT - BASELINE against the threshold, the staging doc's own binding design note, so a mid-game player can never insta-complete a ROTATING/repeatable bounty off counters banked before they took the posting). ONE-SHOT SOFT-LOCK GUARD: `bounty_sewer_survey`/`bounty_silk_line`/`bounty_vermin_grate` key on ONE-SHOT accomplishments (found_phosphor_moss+read_drainage_marker/found_spider_silk/cleared_sewer_vermin) a player can bank BEFORE ever accepting the posting -- under delta semantics that makes them permanently unfulfillable once already done, with no way to un-stick the slip. These three carry `condition_mode: "absolute"`: condition_met reads the counter directly (current >= threshold, baseline ignored, no baseline even snapshotted at accept) -- work already done is honest board pay, and because the underlying accomplishments are one-shot, this can't be gamed into a repeatable grind. APPEND (issue #72, the generated posting batch): 9 more bounties, indices [9..17], appended AFTER the original 9 -- pure append, nothing above reordered, so every existing rotation window (times_slept 0/1, board_loop.json/test_sim_core.gd) stays byte-identical (small early indices never reach the new tail before wrapping past a MUCH larger pool.size()). Grammar/producer trace + pay-formula derivation + REJECTED alternates: docs/archive/staging/board-staging/generated-candidates.json (scripts/generate_postings.py). Every condition key here is cross-checked against a real producer by test_content.gd's _validate_bounties (new, this task). APPEND (issue #97, the bestiary batch): 6 more kill-verb bounties, indices [20..25], pure append. ROTATION NOTE, stated precisely: pure append leaves every window that previously showed [i, i+1, i+2] without wrapping unchanged, but windows that WRAPPED under the old pool size (20) now reach the new tail instead -- the wrap zone starts at old_size-2 = 18, so a slate derived at times_slept ≡ 18 or 19 (mod pool size) changes from [18,19,0]/[19,0,1] to [18,19,20]/[19,20,21]. Concretely: crab_cull_loop's fixture starts at times_slept 17 (pre-state window [17,18,19], unchanged) but its own mid-run sleep moves it to 18, so the LIVE post-sleep window now includes new index 20 (bounty_corusdeer_cull) -- harmless (that canonical asserts the slate only at pre-state; re-verified green), disclosed rather than claimed away.

bounties.giver: The Watch (duty-sergeant's hand, terse, no wasted ink)
bounties.copy: WATCH NOTICE. Goblin raiders, Floodplains road, east approach. Cull two bands. Proof by Guild attestation. 4 gold on turn-in. No spoils claims against the Watch. Second Shift.

bounties.giver: Watch Captain Zevara Sunderscale (dry, overworked, duty-first; longer hand than the sergeant's, and tired)
bounties.copy: Posted by order of the Watch Captain. The Watch is not a wall between every two fools in this city who disagree. End a quarrel with words, both parties still standing, and the Watch pays 3 gold on a guardsman's confirmation. This is cheaper than a cell and I am not above saying so. Z. Sunderscale.

bounties.giver: Krshia Silverfang (measured, proud, Silverfang pragmatism; 'Hrr' used once, sparingly)
bounties.copy: A request, for one with ears. Talk to people. The gate, the Guild, the stalls. What they say freely, you remember, and you tell me over tea. Not spying. Listening. Hrr. The difference matters to Gnolls. 2 gold, and the tea is mine to pour. Krshia Silverfang.

bounties.giver: Olesm Swifttail (earnest clerk-precise; the tactics budget is real to him)
bounties.copy: Request, Guild-posted, standing. The Guild's map of the district is older than my vest. Persons holding [Observe] or a comparable Skill: three fresh observations logged this rotation, any subject of note, reported to the desk. 3 gold from the tactics budget. Neat handwriting appreciated. Not required. Olesm Swifttail, [Tactician].

bounties.giver: Lism Swifttail (Olesm's uncle, [Shopkeeper]; fussy merchant hand: itemized, suspicious of vagueness)
bounties.copy: NOTICE, itemized. Wanted: written confirmation, both items, no substitutions. Item one, that the old drainage marker in the east gallery is still legible. Item two, whether the glow-moss has spread past the first junction. My stockroom shares a wall with that gallery and my insurance man wants ANSWERS, not feelings. Payment 3 gold, exact. I do not pay for 'probably.' L. Swifttail, purveyor.

bounties.giver: Redscar Vell, Bronze-rank adventurer (misspelled-confident; the hand IS the character)
bounties.copy: SILK!! i know were the spiders keep there silk in the sewers. i mean i know ROUGHLY. first one to find the silk-line and mark it on the gild map gets 2 gold of my own coin. its good silk. dont fight the nest. thats MY nest. i called it. REDSCAR VELL, bronze rank (almost silver)

bounties.giver: Erin Solstice (warm runaway babble, self-interrupting; the exclamation points are load-bearing)
bounties.copy: HI! The Wandering Inn (the one on the hill, across the Floodplains, you literally cannot miss it) needs an extra pair of hands! Serve three guests. That's it! That's the whole job! Dinner included, and Lyonette says I can't keep adding exclamation points to these, so: two gold at the Guild. Promise! Erin Solstice, [Innkeeper].

bounties.giver: Lyonette du Marquin (formal diction slipping into sincerity; signs a bare initial)
bounties.copy: The Wandering Inn requires a competent hand at the stew pot for the evening service. Two proper meals, cooked, not burnt, not 'stretched.' Payment of 2 gold, lodged with the Guild, which I am assured is the respectable way these things are done. The kitchen is cleaner than the last notice implied. L.

bounties.giver: Essram, cellarman of the Tailless Cask (aggrieved run-on complaint hand)
bounties.copy: To whoever clears out the wet-vermin under Market Street: my cellar shares a wall with the drainage gallery and I can HEAR them at night, scratching, always at the same brick, the third one down, I have counted. The Guild holds my three gold. Bring me quiet. Essram, cellarman, the Tailless Cask.

bounties.giver: Lyonette du Marquin (formal diction slipping into sincerity; signs a bare initial)
bounties.copy: The common room's light gutters some evenings when nobody's minded it -- the Inn would rather not sit dark while custom's in. Relight it properly, twice over, and the Guild holds 2 gold for the trouble. Not a complicated request. L.

bounties.giver: Erin Solstice (warm runaway babble, self-interrupting; the exclamation points are load-bearing)
bounties.copy: HI AGAIN! Okay so tables get sticky, that's just tables, but THREE of them wiped down properly would be amazing, Lyonette keeps giving me a Look about it. 2 gold at the Guild, same as always! You know where the rags are! Erin Solstice, [Innkeeper].

bounties.giver: Watch Guard (gate detail, brief -- even more clipped than the sergeant's own hand)
bounties.copy: WATCH NOTICE, gate detail. Two passes of the Silverfang stall, one of the bread stall, same shift. Eyes open, nothing more -- pickpockets work a crowd, not an empty street. 2 gold on a guardsman's word. Post standing.

bounties.giver: Duty Sergeant Dresk Ashgrave (the road-cull sergeant's same hand -- terse, no wasted ink)
bounties.copy: BARRACKS NOTICE. Come by twice, state your business, don't loiter. I like knowing who's carrying a blade in this city before I hear about it secondhand. 1 gold for the courtesy. Second Shift.

bounties.giver: Krshia Silverfang (measured, proud, Silverfang pragmatism; 'Hrr' used once, sparingly)
bounties.copy: A second request, small. This city does not warm to strangers quickly, and strangers who do not try stay strangers. Three kind words, three different faces, freely given. Hrr. Good for the city. Good for you. 2 gold, same as before. Krshia Silverfang.

bounties.giver: Duty Sergeant Dresk Ashgrave
bounties.copy: BARRACKS NOTICE, archery butt. Three clean hits, logged by whoever's on the yard. String's provided. Arm's your own. 2 gold, no fuss. Second Shift.

bounties.giver: Olesm Swifttail (earnest clerk-precise; the tactics budget is real to him)
bounties.copy: Request, standing, Guild-posted. The tactics budget wants a rough count of who's actually taking Guild work this rotation, not just registered. Three visits through this door counts you. 3 gold from the same budget as before. Olesm Swifttail, [Tactician].

bounties.giver: Master Coyle (prices everything, never raises his voice)
bounties.copy: Two nests of small-time opportunists work the alleys off my street -- the Turn, and the door with the cheese wedged under it. Amateurs, cutting into trade that isn't theirs to cut into. Clear both and there's 8 gold in it, paid quietly, no questions asked either direction. Master Coyle.
bounties._trace: MODE FIX (review HIGH): absolute -- Wilovan's quest close remove_entity-erases both footpad encounters permanently, so a delta posting dead-ends forever; absolute retires on first completion via the existing one-shot filter (the sewer-trio convention).

bounties.giver: Watch Captain Zevara Sunderscale (dry, overworked, duty-first; longer hand than the sergeant's, and tired)
bounties.copy: A second standing order, same reasoning as the first: I would rather this city talked its way out of two more fights than swung its way through them. Two settled disputes, words only, both parties upright after. 9 gold -- more than the first, because it is harder work than it sounds, and I know exactly how hard. Z. Sunderscale.
bounties._trace: MODE FIX (review MEDIUM): absolute -- persuaded_someone producers are all one-shot dialogue resolutions (~7 lifetime); a delta-2 posting can strand a player who spent all but one before accepting. One honest payout, then retired.

bounties._comment: Issue #81 (exploration & optional content): retrofits frozen_cache (floodplains) to 'pay real', per the gap-analysis finding that it was the one discovery in the game rewarding nothing but a toast -- frozen_cache now ALSO grants gold directly (data/skeleton_scene.json), and this posting lets the finder report it for a small bonus. condition_mode absolute (the sewer-trio precedent): found_the_frozen_cache is a one-shot accomplishment a player can bank before ever seeing this posting (the freeze-the-pond secret has no other gate), so delta semantics would strand it forever for anyone who found it first. Giver: Redscar Vell, the SAME bronze-rank treasure-hunter voice already shipped on bounty_silk_line -- a natural fit (his own posting already brags about knowing where loot hides in the sewers; the pond cache is his kind of rumor).
bounties.giver: Redscar Vell, Bronze-rank adventurer (misspelled-confident; the hand IS the character)
bounties.copy: found somthing froze in the pond out past the inn once. a strongbox, silt an all. didnt open it myself, bad luck to rob the dead twice. if you already crakced it open, 2 gold for telling me you found it too. i like being right. REDSCAR VELL, bronze rank (almost silver)

bounties._comment: Issue #24: HR-II landed the Rock Crab encounter this task (rock_crab_nest, floodplains, respawns:true -- data/skeleton_scene.json), so this posting graduates out of the held-out staging pool per the staged entry's own instruction ('Keep this entry OUT of the live pool until HR-II lands'). Copy/giver/gold carried verbatim from docs/archive/staging/board-staging/guild-bounties.json's bounty_crab_cull entry; the ONLY change is the condition key, which the staging entry itself flagged as a placeholder (`_NEEDS_NEW_BANK_rock_crabs_culled`) -- now the real bank rock_crab_nest's on_victory produces. No condition_mode (defaults to delta, this file's own top comment): rock_crabs_culled is a REPEATABLE counter (the encounter respawns), matching the staging doc's binding design note that repeatable counters must snapshot-and-diff, never read absolute -- the SAME shape as bounty_road_cull's won_combat, not the sewer-trio's one-shot absolute mode.
bounties.giver: Beshta of the hunt camp (Gnoll hunter hand: short lines, hunt-family plural, one warning)
bounties.copy: Hunt notice. Rock Crabs wake with the rains, and a shell the size of a cart does not care that your leg was in the way. Two culled from the east hills, shown by shell-plate. 5 gold, pooled by the hunt families. Do not trouble the Corusdeer herd. Antlers freely shed only. Beshta, for the camp.

bounties._comment: Issue #97 (bestiary expansion, THE PAYOFF): the stray Corusdeer's own renewable cull -- same hunt-camp voice/giver as bounty_crab_cull (Beshta), same east-hills floodplains territory. Pay via scripts/generate_postings.py's own recovered formula: fight pillar 2.0g/unit * 2 units * T1 mult 1.0 = 4g. Producer: corusdeer_range's on_victory (data/maps/floodplains/floodplains.json), respawns:true -- delta-mode (default), the SAME repeatable-counter shape bounty_crab_cull/bounty_road_cull already use.
bounties.giver: Beshta of the hunt camp (Gnoll hunter hand: short lines, hunt-family plural, one warning)
bounties.copy: Hunt notice. A stray buck's broken from the herd, east hills, antlers hot enough to start a grass fire if you let it stand too long. Two culled, shown by an antler each. 4 gold, pooled by the hunt families. The HERD stays off this notice -- one stray only. Beshta, for the camp.

bounties._comment: Issue #97: the razorbeak nest's own renewable cull -- same Beshta hunt-camp voice, same floodplains territory. Pay: 2.0g/unit * 2 units * T1 1.0 = 4g. Producer: razorbeak_nest's on_victory, respawns:true, delta-mode.
bounties.giver: Beshta of the hunt camp (Gnoll hunter hand: short lines, hunt-family plural, one warning)
bounties.copy: Hunt notice. Dino-birds nesting loud again, west scrape. Bold in pairs, nothing alone. Two culled, shown by a wing each. 4 gold, pooled by the hunt families. Beshta, for the camp.

bounties._comment: Issue #97: the boulevard Mothbears' own renewable cull -- same Master Coyle voice as bounty_alley_cull (Invrisil's own established fight-pillar giver). Pay: 2.0g/unit * 1 unit * T3 2.0 = 4g. Single-kill by design (matches kingslayer_cull's own reasoning) -- the night-gated respawn cycle (dormant until next sleep AND until the next night phase) makes a 2-kill delta a genuinely awkward ask for a canonical to prove cleanly; the bounty itself reads fine at 1.
bounties.giver: Master Coyle
bounties.copy: The lantern-line draws them after dark -- moth-winged bears, heavy enough to crack a cart axle. One culled, after dark, shown by Guild attestation. 4 gold on turn-in. Coyle.

bounties._comment: Issue #97: the Kingslayer Spider's own renewable cull -- deliberately a single-kill posting (an apex predator, not a farming grind; the harness cell kingslayer_den_t4_solo is MEASURED-only, not a comfortable-band contract). Giver: Selys (the Guild's own desk, already the board's central voice). Pay: 2.0g/unit * 1 unit * T4 2.5 = 5g. Producer: kingslayer_den's on_victory (data/maps/dungeon/dungeon_approach.json), respawns:true, delta-mode.
bounties.giver: Selys Sharpear
bounties.copy: Guild notice, Silver-rank and up. Something's nesting in the approach galleries again -- black-and-silver, big, not shy about it. One confirmed kill, shell-plate as proof. 5 gold. Ask twice before you go alone. Selys, for the Guild.

bounties._comment: Issue #97: the Forge's own miscalibrated-golem cull -- Pallass's FIRST live combat posting. Giver: Grimalkin (the forge tier's own established voice, pallass_forge.json). Pay: 2.0g/unit * 2 units * T5 3.0 = 12g. Producer: forge_calibration_golem's on_victory (data/maps/pallass/pallass_forge.json), respawns:true, delta-mode.
bounties.giver: Grimalkin
bounties.copy: Forge-tier notice. Command spells drift, and a drifted golem doesn't know a shipment from a person. Two put down properly, cores intact for the smiths. 12 gold. Grimalkin.

bounties._comment: Issue #97: the Market's own stone-golem cull (id keeps `watchgolem` -- ids are not player-facing; every player-facing surface says 'Stone Golem(s)' per the controller naming ruling) -- Pallass's SECOND live combat posting. Giver: market_stallkeeper (the market tier's own established voice, pallass_market.json). Pay: 2.0g/unit * 2 units * T5 3.0 = 12g. Producer: market_watchgolems' on_victory (data/maps/pallass/pallass_market.json), respawns:true, delta-mode.
bounties.giver: The Market Stallkeepers (pooled)
bounties.copy: Stallholders' notice. Two of the stone golems posted by the empty stalls have stopped answering to anyone. Two put down, plating returned. 12 gold, pooled by the row.

bounties._comment: Issue #91 (the hour-4 spine), indices [26..28], pure append: POST_GAME STANDING ORDERS -- `requires: {post_game: 1}` (WIBounties.requires_met, board_bounties()'s pool filter) keeps all three OUT of the pool until the epilogue banks post_game, so every pre-post_game rotation window stays BYTE-IDENTICAL (incl. the wrap zone: pallass_watchgolem_loop's ts-25 window still reads [25,0,1] over the 26-entry pre-gate pool); no shipped post_game fixture sits at ts >= 24, so no live window shifts post-gate either. All delta-mode (repeatable, on_victory-keyed producers all respawns:true). Pay via generate_postings.py's recovered formula: den 2.0*2*T4 2.5 = 10g; lantern-line 2.0*2*T3 2.0 = 8g; road order 2.0*3*T1 1.0 = 6g (won_combat's CHEAPEST producers are T1 road fights -- priced to the floor tier so the posting can't out-pay its easiest grind).
bounties.giver: Selys Sharpear
bounties.copy: Guild standing order, Silver-rank and up. The approach galleries do not stay swept -- whatever nests in that seam nests DEEP, and it recruits. Two confirmed kills per rotation, shell-plate as proof, 10 gold. This notice does not come down. Selys, for the Guild.

bounties.giver: Master Coyle
bounties.copy: A standing arrangement, for professionals. The lantern-line draws the moth-winged bears every dark season and my carters have families. Two culled per settlement of the account, after dark, Guild-attested. 8 gold, paid without commentary. Coyle.

bounties.giver: Watch Captain Zevara Sunderscale (dry, overworked, duty-first)
bounties.copy: Standing order of the Watch, posted for whoever keeps ending up in the reports. The roads out of this city do not police themselves and my roster says we cannot either. Three engagements won, anywhere the Watch's writ runs, confirmed by attestation. 6 gold per settlement. I would rather pay you than bury patrols. Z. Sunderscale.

bounties._comment: Issue #91 (hour-4 spine), indices [29..31], pure append: three MORE post_game standing orders, keyed to the three NEW respawns:true encounters this task added (gallery_vermin_nest/riverfarm_thicket_patch/boulevard_duel_ring, sim_combat_batch.gd's DUNGEON_CELLS/RIVERFARM_CELLS/INVRISIL_CELLS). Same `requires: {post_game: 1}` gate as [26..28] above -- byte-identical pre-post_game (the filtered pool stays 26 entries; post-post_game it grows 29->32). All delta-mode (repeatable, on_victory-keyed, all three producers respawns:true), 2-unit convention (the crab_cull/corusdeer_cull/razorbeak_cull/forge_golem_cull/watchgolem_cull precedent, not the 1-unit 'apex predator' shape). Pay via generate_postings.py's recovered formula: gallery watch 2.0*2*T4 2.5 = 10g; thicket watch 2.0*2*T3 2.0 = 8g; boulevard duels 2.0*2*T3 2.0 = 8g. Givers reuse each region's own already-established fight-pillar voice: Selys (T4 dungeon, matching bounty_standing_den_watch/bounty_kingslayer_cull), Eloise (Riverfarm's own witch, the thicket's actual source), Master Coyle (Invrisil, matching bounty_alley_cull/bounty_mothbear_cull/bounty_standing_lantern_line).
bounties.giver: Selys Sharpear
bounties.copy: Guild standing order, Silver-rank and up. The reopened side-galleries past the trap gauntlet never stay swept either -- the same leak that fed the vermin nest the first time still feeds it. Two confirmed kills per rotation, shell-plate as proof, 10 gold. This notice does not come down. Selys, for the Guild.

bounties.giver: Eloise
bounties.copy: A standing arrangement, small enough to be honest about. My own hedge-craft sheds offshoots I don't always catch in time, and a stray thicket-remnant is still thorn enough to open a leg to the bone. Two cleared per settlement, no questions about method. 8 gold. Eloise.

bounties.giver: Master Coyle
bounties.copy: Standing arrangement, for regulars. My ring pays out same as always -- two rounds won against whoever's leaning on the wall that day, Guild-attested, 8 gold per settlement. Coyle.
